description: Defines a custom Android TV view component 'ContinueWatchingCard' for displaying a thumbnail, progress bar, and title. Designed with focus handling and styling for a TV interface.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingCard
classes.description: A custom CardView representing a 'Continue Watching' item with thumbnail, progress indicator, and title, optimized for Android TV navigation.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentItem object to the view, setting the title and progress bar accordingly.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on screen density.
